steps: Immediately reduce motor load or shut down if critical
Check cooling fan operation - ensure it's running
Clean ventilation openings and cooling fins
Inspect for blocked air vents
Verify ambient temperature is within specifications
Check motor bearings for excessive friction
Allow motor to cool before restarting
Stop machine immediately if vibration is severe
Check for loose mounting bolts and tighten
Inspect bearings for wear or damage
Verify component alignment
Check for unbalanced rotating parts
Inspect foundation and mounting surfaces
Use vibration analysis tools if available
Check air filter - clean or replace if dirty
Inspect entire system for air leaks
Verify compressor oil level
Check pressure regulator settings
Inspect air lines for blockages
Check compressor intake for restrictions
Verify compressor is running at full capacity
Stop conveyor and inspect belt alignment
Check belt tension - adjust if necessary
Inspect pulleys for wear or damage
Clean material buildup from pulleys
Verify frame alignment
Check belt condition for damage
Adjust tracking mechanism if available
